ValidationRule.description: Makes Commitment End Date required if the Job/Placement Type is Short-Term
ValidationRule.errorConditionFormula: AND( NOT( OR( $Profile.Name = "System Administrator", $Profile.Name = "Salesforce API Only System Integrations" ) ), ISPICKVAL(Job_Type__c, "short-term"), ISBLANK(ETJ_Commitment_End_Date__c), NOT(ISBLANK( Start_Date__c )) )
ValidationRule.errorMessage: Commitment End Date is required for Short-Term Jobs.
